text_block_list.text:
To borrow equipment for my trainee horse girl,
I paid a visit to Ikuno Dictus
on the General Affairs Committee.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No issues detected.
This should still be fully serviceable.

Ikuno Dictus was maintaining equipment
with an uncharacteristically gentle smile.
Seeing such a peaceful scene softened my own expression.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, how may I assist you?
choice_data_list: I'd like to borrow horseshoe maintenance tools.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Horseshoe maintenance tools, correct?
Could you provide the specific details of what you require?

Once I explained the details of the tools I needed,
Ikuno Dictus went to fetch them.
And then—

What she handed over looked somewhat aged.
However, having been meticulously cared for,
there appeared to be absolutely no issue using them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My apologies.
I regret offering such an older set, but we have no other spares...

On the contrary, it was impressive that such older tools
were kept in such pristine condition.
I told her it was all thanks to her diligence.

On the contrary, it was impressive that such older tools
were kept in such pristine condition.
I told her it was all thanks to her diligence.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, it is only natural.
After all, I have been saved by them time and again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In two major instances, to be precise.
I have had experiences where precious tools came to my aid.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —The first was when I fell ill.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Unable to move my body as intended or run as I wished,
I was plunged into despair—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My parents gave me a bicycle.
The exhilarating rotation of its two wheels reminded me
of the sheer joy of running freely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However, later on, the second incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
While riding the bicycle, I took a fall and suffered an injury.
Not only was I unable to run, but I could no longer
even ride the bicycle—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: An unprecedented anxiety overtook me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I was rescued once again.
By sheer fortune, a wonderful encounter awaited me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I met a practitioner who was both a body therapist and a farrier.
With passion and skill, they crafted the optimal horseshoes for me—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And thus, my freedom was restored.
I became able not just to pedal a bicycle,
but to run on my own two feet.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that I am capable of running today
is certainly thanks to my parents and the farrier, but also—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to precious tools like bicycles and horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is why I sincerely wish
to treat every single tool with utmost care.

I see—her devoted attitude toward equipment stemmed from
gratitude and a desire to repay the favor
to those around her and the tools themselves.
choice_data_list: Don't forget to take care of yourself too.
Make sure you take care of yourself too.
I'll be sure to treat them with care.

text_block_list.text:
I see—her devoted attitude toward equipment stemmed from
gratitude and a desire to repay the favor
to those around her and the tools themselves.
choice_data_list: Don't forget to take care of yourself too.
Make sure you take care of yourself too.
I'll be sure to treat them with care.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall keep that in mind. Without maintaining one's own health,
one cannot properly manage tools, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please take good care of yourself as well.
For your own sake, and for the sake of those precious to you.

As I continued talking with Ikuno Dictus
after that—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to your continued cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I pray that your small gesture of consideration
brings good fortune to someone.

As I continued talking with Ikuno Dictus
after that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —IKUNO-SAAANNNN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As Class President, I have arrived to borrow
the necessary materials for our class event!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
As a Health Committee member, I came to borrow
some supplies for physical measurements, but—
is now a good time?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Whenever you require anything, please feel free.

Following that, Ikuno Dictus briskly handled
her duties on the General Affairs Committee.

I was reminded once more that the daily successes
of the students may well be built upon
her steadfast support.
